# `nlink-lab node restart`

## Reference

<!-- cli-ref:start (generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit) -->

```text
Restart a container node, and put back what its new network namespace lacks: its links, bridge ports and mgmt veth, sysctls and `run` commands

Usage: nlink-lab node restart [OPTIONS] <NODE>

Arguments:
  <NODE>
          

Options:
  -L, --lab <LAB>
          The lab. Default: `$NLINK_LAB`, then the one `nlink-lab use` selected, then the only running lab

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
